report.explanation: Current telemetry does not support the operator hypothesis of a faulty deployment causing checkout errors. Traces show all checkout, order, payment, inventory and DB spans returning 200/ok. Gateway metrics show /v1/checkout 200 rate ~32 with 502 count 0, and p95 latency ~247ms. The only deployment record is order 1.0.0 with no previous version, which cannot establish deployment-caused errors. No error evidence exists to bound a root cause.
missing_evidence: Error/failure telemetry (5xx, error logs, failed spans) for checkout or downstream services during the incident window
Logs evidence (excluded from context) to confirm or refute checkout errors
Deployment history with prior version and timing relative to any error onset
Latency/error baselines to assess whether observed p95 is anomalous
